abstract:
|
  Fix cycle round 3 (the capped round) on issue #65's citation-resolver gate, addressing an Opus adversarial reviewer's 1-Major/3-Minor REJECT of round 2 (commit 4aea118). Verified base first (HEAD 4aea118, branch car/tooling-65) before any edit.

  The central finding (MAJOR-R2-1) was a second instance of the exact defect class this gate exists to stop: round 2's own header made an unmeasured claim ("zero backtick tokens on their citing lines" for all three view-train findings) that was false for one of the three. Verified by opening the historical commit directly (git show 3076a40), confirming the citing line carried a StalenessMs token that would have false-hit under case-insensitive matching but correctly missed under the gate's own case-sensitive choice - meaning the content anchor's historical record is a full 3-for-3 true positives, not 2-for-2. Per the round's governing rule, this was moved from prose to a pinned assertion: a new fixture reproduces the exact structural shape (exact-case declaration far above the citation, a lowercase collision inside the anchor window, the exact-case reoccurrence outside it) and asserts both the case-insensitive false-hit and case-sensitive true-miss directly, sharing extracted helper functions with the production check rather than duplicating logic.

  The three Minors were straightforward, verifiable fixes: a line-count correction using the gate's own mandated method rather than wc -l; a standing re-verification loop closing the gap where declared-exempt extensions were checked once at landing but never again; and a resolver-routing fix so an ambiguous elided citation reports its real candidates instead of an empty list. All three are pinned with real, green assertions against either the live corpus (zero violators observed) or new scratch fixtures.

  Every number in this round's diff was re-derived rather than carried on faith: the historical commit's exact text, the config.go line positions relative to the anchor window, the corrected drill.md line count, and the round-2 corpus totals (258 files, 188 coordinates) were all re-measured this round, with the corpus-total re-measurement performed via a temporary diagnostic that was verified reverted byte-for-byte before the final commit.

  Suites confirmed at final HEAD 63a5c55: scripts/tests 223/0/4-skipped/227, scripts/probes 24/24, CodeCitationPolicy.Tests.ps1 in isolation 13/13. Go, Node, and probe-yard-snapshot.mjs were not re-run since only the one test file changed this round, stated plainly per the brief.
